[[Vietnam national football team|Vietnam]] to compete in the [[2027 AFC Asian Cup]]. ==Teams== A total of 14 teams is participating in the 2026–27 edition of the V.League 1: twelve from [[2025–26 V.League 1|previous season]] and two from [[2025–26 V.League 2|V.League 2]] ===Format changes=== ====Relegation slots==== Starting from this season, there were 2 direct relegation spots while the relegation play-off game has been removed, unlike the [[2025–26 V.League 1|2025–26 season]] which changed back to the initial 1,5 relegation spots.{{cite web|url=https://bongdaplus.vn/v-league/v-league-2025-26-thay-doi-dang-khen-tang-suat-xuong-hang-4636882503.html|title=V.League 2025/26 thay đổi đáng khen, tăng suất xuống hạng|website=bongdaplus.vn|date=27 March 2025|access-date=27 March 2026 |language=vi}} ====New rules==== The 2026–27 season introduced several [[Laws of the Game (association football)|rule]] changes from the [[2026 FIFA World Cup]] and updates from the Laws of the Game from the [[International Football Association Board]]:{{cite web | url=https://downloads.theifab.com/downloads/laws-of-the-game-202627-single-pages | title=Laws of the Game 26/27 | publisher=[[International Football Association Board]] | work=theifab.com | date=8 work=vnexpress.net | date=1 June 2026 | accessdate=1 September 2026 | author=Hoàng An (according to [[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]]) | language=vi}} * 10-second substitutions: Players being [[Substitute (association football)|substituted]] had ten seconds to exit the field; otherwise, the substitute had to wait for one minute before entering the match. * 5-second restarts: A visual 5-second countdown was shown by the referee for throw-ins and goal kicks in situations of time-wasting. If the ball was not put into play in time, a restart was awarded to the opposing team; a [[corner kick]] was awarded if the infraction occurred with a goal kick. *[[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|Penalty shoot-out]] and the outcome of the match: Removal of the automatic caution (YC) for the kicker if they and the goalkeeper offend at the same time. * Expanded [[video assistant referee]] (VAR): The VAR could review and overturn wrongly awarded corner kicks, certain attacking fouls, and clear mistakes on red cards given from a second yellow card. * Player leaving the field in protest: Players or officials who left the field in protest were sent off. ===Changes from previous season=== {| class="wikitable" |- !
